disorder-name.detail: Clinical cohort of mild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) patients. Normative model built from Cam-CAN healthy participants was applied to individual mTBI patients as Z-score deviation maps for SVM-based classification.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We employed a dataset originally measured by Kaltiainen and colleagues [27,28], comprising resting-state MEG recordings from 25 mild traumatic injury patients and 20 healthy controls."

dataset-of-origin.detail: The mTBI patient dataset was collected at Aalto Neuroimaging MEG Core, Aalto University School of Science, Espoo, Finland (originally measured by Kaltiainen et al.). No named public dataset; single-site.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The MEG measurements were performed at Aalto Neuroimaging MEG Core, Aalto University School of Science, Espoo, Finland"
dataset-of-origin.location: Italinna2023.pdf.md: Methods / mTBI patients and healthy controls, L118

age.detail: Mean age calculated from individual patient ages in Table 1 (N=25; sum=1039, mean=41.56); Table 1 shows average 41.6 and text rounds to 42. Min=20, Max=59 from text. SD not reported for the patient group; calculated from Table 1 individual values: SD=10.90 (sample SD).
age.supporting_text: "The patient group consisted of 25 mild traumatic brain injury patients (11 females, 14 males) with a mean age of 42 years (range 20-59 years)."
